incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=infra-inference-embedder severity=high (INC-9012) — 5xx spike in eu-prod cluster. Trigger: error-rate > 15% over 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-9012. Paging on-call: @priya_oncall :rotating_light:
Priya Gupta: ACKed INC-9012. I'm taking ownership. Opening triage bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/9012. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: I'm seeing a Redis timeout storm and KV-cache evictions on the embedder pods in eu-west-1. Errors correlate with burst at 12:03. Attaching short cmd output in case helpful: ```kubectl -n embedder get pods | grep eu | awk '{print $1, $3}'```
Morgan Lee: looping in — I'm on a customer call, will hand off. @Priya please own; I'll stay on logs in background.
Priya Gupta: Roger. Initial customer impact: embeddings requests experiencing ~10-20% 5xx and 3-12s additional latency for affected requests. Noting affected customers: partner-integrations and search-svc.
Priya Gupta: Running mitigation from runbook: scale dedicated pool and warm caches. Command I'll run now: `infractl scale-pool --name dedicated-embed-eu --add-nodes 3`
infra-bot: scale request accepted for pool=dedicated-embed-eu, target_add=3. Expected provisioning ~4-6 minutes. Autoscaler state: backoff cleared.
Alex Chen: Started a cache-warmup on new nodes and bumping connection pool to redis: `redis-cli -h cache-eu INFO replication` — seeing timeouts ~200ms per call which explains increased tail latency.
Priya Gupta: @Morgan can you start a quick log grep for the top error signature so we can track in dashboard? `kubectl logs -n embedder -l app=embedder --since=5m | grep -i "timeout" | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr`
Morgan Lee: on it, running now. Quick snapshot: majority are `i/o timeout to redis` and a smaller fraction `kvcache miss -> fallback compute`
Priya Gupta: Claiming INC-9012 in PagerDuty now and setting status=investigating. ETA for mitigation effect: 20-30m. I'll post every 10 minutes or on major change.
Alex Chen: After initiating scale, error rate trending down to ~8% within 3 minutes. Latency tail improving slightly. Still seeing occasional timeouts from one redis pod; recommending failover of that pod if it doesn't recover in 5m.
Priya Gupta: Copy. @cs-team-bot pinged to notify affected customers that we're mitigating (no customer-visible outage, degraded errors/latency).
infra-bot: Detected redis-pod-3: CrashLoopBackOff -> restarting. Recovery attempt initiated by k8s.
Morgan Lee: I can take over the PD responder in ~12 minutes once I'm off the call — handing active ownership to @Priya for now. Leaving monitoring to Alex and Priya.
Priya Gupta: Thanks. I'm marking owner=Priya Gupta in PD and suppressing auto-escalation. Will follow up with post-incident notes if duration >30m. Next update in ~10m or on resolution. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: Auto-escalation suppressed; owner set to Priya Gupta. No further escalation unless owner clears or timeout reached.
